title: Consumer Transportation Costs and the Value of E-Commerce: Evidence from the Dutch Apparel Industry
eligible_reason: The package contains only the structural-model code (Sections 5-6: multiple-discrete-choice demand model, counterfactuals) in MATLAB; no reduced-form or DiD code. The paper's DiD-type evidence (flagged by full-text search) cannot be checked from the package; the shipped code models consumer-to-store distance as a continuous characteristic. Recorded as not eligible: no shipped DiD specification and no data. Re-check against the article text if it becomes available.
design_notes: replication_code/run.m drives loaddata.m (main data matrix with distances to 40 retailer-channel options), estimate_main.m, likelihood_q_rc.m, model_fit.m, elasticity_and_costs.m, counterfactual_*.m. No Stata/R files.
data_files_note: readme.txt: AiMark (GfK) panel data available only after a review proposal, data support agreement and NDA; raw data and data-cleaning code available on the same terms. Nothing shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text, empty regression inventory because code is MATLAB). Design eligibility of any reduced-form DiD in the paper is UNVERIFIED; even if it qualified, neither code nor data for it are in the package.
